candidate_evidence.quote: This feasibility study will assess the clinical potential of a new imaging approach to detect viable high grade glioma (HGG)

role_evidence.quote: FET (5 mCi, 185 MBq) will be administered IV as a bolus with dynamic acquisition of brain PET/MRI data from the time of injection through 60 min after injection.

arms: PET imaging of system L amino acid transport with FET and hypoxia imaging with FMISO

role_evidence.quote: The patient will undergo IV administration of FMISO (5 mCi, 185 MBq) in an uptake room in the AIF.

arms: PET imaging of system L amino acid transport with FET and hypoxia imaging with FMISO

coder_notes: Imaging-only feasibility study (Early Phase 1). GBM is not named (grade III or IV glioma, pediatric and adult). MGMT and IDH are mentioned only as clinical information that may be accessed for correlation, not as planned biomarker endpoints, so not listed.
